question: Which of the following is a 's' block element?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rubidium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rubidium (Rb)** is an element that belongs to the s-block of the periodic table.
 
• It is an alkali metal and is found in Group 1 of the periodic table.
 
• Rubidium has an atomic number of 37 and is characterized by having a single electron in its outermost s-orbital.
 
• Alkali metals, including Rubidium, are known for their high reactivity and are typically stored under oil to prevent reaction with air or water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **s-block Elements**

 
 
• The s-block elements are those in which the outermost electrons occupy an s-orbital. These elements are found in Groups 1 and 2 of the periodic table.
 
• Group 1 elements are known as alkali metals and include Lithium (Li), Sodium (Na), Potassium (K), Rubidium (Rb), Cesium (Cs), and Francium (Fr).
 
• Group 2 elements are known as alkaline earth metals and include Beryllium (Be), Magnesium (Mg), Calcium (Ca), Strontium (Sr), Barium (Ba), and Radium (Ra).
 
• These elements are characterized by their high reactivity, especially with water, and they form basic (alkaline) solutions when they react with water.
 
 
 
• **d-block Elements**
 
 
• The d-block elements are those in which the outermost electrons occupy a d-orbital. These elements are found in Groups 3 to 12 of the periodic table.
 
• They are often referred to as transition metals and include elements like Iron (Fe), Copper (Cu), and Gold (Au).
 
• Transition metals are characterized by their ability to form variable oxidation states and colored compounds.
 
• They are also known for their catalytic properties and high conductivity of electricity and heat.
